name: BABEL
summary: 为 AMASS 连续运动捕捉序列增加动作语义和起止时间标注，描述动作之间的时间结构。
summaryEn: Action semantics and start/end annotations for continuous AMASS motion, exposing temporal structure between actions.
scale: About 43 hours annotated; dense release covers about 37.5 hours
scaleZh: 约 43 小时标注；稠密发布部分约 37.5 小时
organizations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and University of Konstanz
organizationsZh: 马克斯普朗克智能系统研究所与康斯坦茨大学
license: Non-commercial research license; no redistribution; AMASS terms also apply
licenseZh: 非商业研究许可，禁止再分发；另适用 AMASS 条款
access: Official annotation download; motion data obtained separately from AMASS
accessZh: 官方标注下载；运动数据需另从 AMASS 获取
verdict: 带时间语义的连续人体运动
wmNote: 标注结合原始运动可研究语义条件状态演化；标注文件本身不包含完整运动，且与 AMASS 重叠。
wmNoteEn: Pair annotations with source motion for semantic state evolution; annotations alone lack full motion and overlap AMASS.

evidence.statement: Frame/sequence annotations index underlying motion sequences; AMASS motion must be obtained separately and must not be counted as new acquisition.
